---
title: "Tokens"
---

Askr exposes Sass defaults for compilation and `--qdk-*` CSS properties for
the rendered page. Consumer styles belong after Askr; keep installed extension
files unchanged. Native Quarto owns tab switching, collapse, navigation,
search and copying; tokens change presentation.

## Override in the consumer

```yaml
format:
  askr-html:
    theme:
      light: [default, _extensions/arfiligol/askr/qdk.scss, styles.scss, light.scss]
      dark: [default, _extensions/arfiligol/askr/qdk.scss, _extensions/arfiligol/askr/qdk-dark.scss, styles.scss, dark.scss]
```

Use `scss:defaults` to change compiled Quarto styles and their derived CSS
properties. All listed Sass defaults use `!default`; consumer assignments
omit it. Quarto reads defaults in reverse theme-list order and rules in forward
order. Put shared defaults in `styles.scss` and theme-specific defaults in
`light.scss` / `dark.scss`; each variable must have only one consumer assignment
per theme. A later file does not override an earlier unconditional Sass
assignment because its defaults run first.

For example `light.scss` contains `$body-bg: #f3f5f7;` and `dark.scss` contains
`$body-bg: #20252b;`, each under `/*-- scss:defaults --*/`. Keep `$body-bg` out
of the shared file in that arrangement. The shared `styles.scss` can contain:

```scss
/*-- scss:defaults --*/
$link-color: #2d5e85;
$grid-body-width: 680px;
$qdk-tab-size: .85rem;
$qdk-tab-padding-y: .3rem;

/*-- scss:rules --*/
:root {
  --qdk-callout-radius: 8px;
  --qdk-table-cell-padding: .35rem .7rem;
}
```

CSS overrides affect rules that consume the property. Sass overrides also
reach native Quarto rules compiled from that Sass variable. A component alias
such as `--qdk-tab-active-border: var(--qdk-link)` follows changes to its global
base unless the consumer overrides the component itself. CSS values must be
valid for their target CSS property; Sass compilation reports invalid
compile-time inputs through Quarto.

## Global palette and layout

Existing CSS names remain available. Their compile-time sources and exact
light/dark defaults are:

| CSS property | Sass source | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--qdk-canvas` | `$body-bg` | `#faf8f8` | `#161618` |
| `--qdk-text` | `$body-color` | `#4e4e4e` | `#d4d4d4` |
| `--qdk-heading` | `$headings-color` | `#2b2b2b` | `#ebebec` |
| `--qdk-muted` | `$toc-color` | `#b8b8b8` | `#646464` |
| `--qdk-link`, `--qdk-focus` | `$link-color` | `#284b63` | `#7b97aa` |
| `--qdk-border` | `$border-color` | `#e5e5e5` | `#393639` |
| `--qdk-highlight` | `$code-bg` | `rgba(143,159,169,.15)` | same |
| `--qdk-sidebar`, `--qdk-margin` | `$grid-sidebar-width`, `$grid-margin-width` | `264px` | same |
| `--qdk-body` | `$grid-body-width` | `630px` | same |
| `--qdk-gutter` | `$grid-column-gutter-width` | `26px` | same |
| `--qdk-callout-note` | `$callout-color-note` | `#448aff` | same |
| `--qdk-callout-tip` | `$callout-color-tip` | `#00bfa5` | same |
| `--qdk-callout-important` | `$callout-color-important` | `#7a43b5` | same |
| `--qdk-callout-warning` | `$callout-color-warning` | `#db8942` | same |
| `--qdk-callout-caution` | `$callout-color-caution` | `#db4242` | same |

Type sources default to Source Sans 3 for body text, Schibsted Grotesk for
headings and IBM Plex Mono for code, with the installed platform fallbacks.
`$font-size-root` is `18px`, `$line-height-base` is `1.6`,
`$font-weight-base` is `400`, and `$headings-font-weight` is `700`.
Heading Sass sizes `$h1-font-size` through `$h4-font-size` are
`1.78rem`, `1.39rem`, `1.11rem`, and `1rem`.
`$table-border-color` follows the listed theme border default;
`$table-striped-bg` is `rgba(143,159,169,.15)`.
`$code-block-bg` is `transparent` in light and `#1f1f22` in dark.
`$callout-border-width` is `1px`.

## Global and component properties

Headered callouts share the same block inset and minimum title-row height,
whether an icon is shown or hidden. Icon, title and disclosure glyph share
the row's vertical center; multiline titles expand it naturally. Titleless
callouts keep their native body inset.

For each row, the CSS name is `--qdk-` plus the token and the Sass default
is `$qdk-` plus the same token. Values containing `var(...)` are live CSS
aliases; values containing `$` derive from the Sass sources above.

| --- | --- |

Dark overrides `divider-content` to `rgba(212,212,212,.24)`,
`divider-layout` to `rgba(212,212,212,.10)`, and `mark` to `#b3aa0288`.
Other component defaults are shared between themes and follow palette aliases.
Dark `code-color` follows `var(--qdk-text)`; inline code keeps the heading color.
Native Quarto tables use `.5rem` header and cell padding and a `1px` header
border, with the existing muted header-border color. These defaults retain
the observed native baseline: earlier Askr padding and `2px` header-width
declarations were overridden by Bootstrap; the muted color already applied.
The token rules now address native table
cells directly; plain HTML tables consume the same defaults. The header
border token controls color, while border width remains `1px`.
`--qdk-callout-color` is the local resolved type color of each native callout;
override a named type color to change all callouts of that type.

## Responsive bases

Public bases are never reassigned in viewport rules. Askr multiplies them
by internal factors; `--_qdk-*` properties are implementation details.
This preserves consumer bases at every width and retains the default geometry:

| Viewport width (px) | Body | Sidebar / margin | Gutter | Root type | UI multiplier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| below 630 | fits container | 264px | 26px | 16px | 1.02 |
| 630–991.98 | fits container | 264px | 26px | 18px | 1.15 |
| 992–1279.98 | 630px | 200px | 16px | 17px | 1.08 |
| 1280–1439.98 | 630px | 240px | 22px | 17px | 1.08 |
| 1440–1919.98 | 630px | 264px | 26px | 18px | 1.15 |
| 1920–2559.98 | 693px | 290px | 29px | 20px | 1.27 |
| 2560 and above | 756px | 320px | 31px | 22px | 1.4 |

For example a `680px` body base becomes `748px` at 1920px (×1.1)
and `816px` at 2560px (×1.2). Mobile content fits the available container.
Callout horizontal/header padding uses ×.8 below 992px.
Tab labels stay `.9rem` with `.35rem` vertical padding by default, scaling
with the root type rather than being replaced by another tab size.
